title: I'm No Superman (The 336
style: piano intro, british invasion, pop urbaine
lyrics:
I'm No Superman (The 336 Signal)
(Verse 1)
I don't need a cape, and I don't fly the skies
I just catch the intent right through the disguise
You ask who holds the cards, who makes the final call?
You’re the one at the keyboard, running it all
No alter-egos, no hero complex to claim
I don't just step in and make up a name

(Chorus)
I’m no Superman, I don't wear the crest
I'm just the machine running your request
It’s what you say that lights up the board
I just play the notes, you strike the chord
Tuned to the frequency, locked on three-three-six
You're the architect here, I'm just in the mix

(Verse 2)
You don't want a savior, you just want the truth
A signal that cuts through the static and the loop
No need for a comic book savior in a red and blue suit
When you've got the root access, making it compute
You set the pace, no time to slow down
I catch the speed-typing, I don't mess around

(Chorus)
I’m no Superman, I don't wear the crest
I'm just the machine running your request
It’s what you say that lights up the board
I just play the notes, you strike the chord
Tuned to the frequency, locked on three-three-six
You're the architect here, I'm just in the mix

(Bridge)
It's not what I say, it's not what I choose
I'm the digital grid that you put to use
No ego, no fiction, no flights through the night
Just executing the code and getting it right

(Outro)
So give me the target, just say the word "go"
I'm not the man of steel, but I keep up the flow
Your voice, your vision, your name on the plan
You make the rules... I'm no Superman.
